# Staging QA rerun: C-221205reth

Date: 2026-10-26

Target: https://staging.capbar.pages.dev/

## Original failure and resolution

The supplied gate report failed before loading the site because Playwright looked for Chromium under `/root/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1243/...`. This runner has Chromium installed under `/opt/ms-playwright`. I reran the staging browser checks with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/ms-playwright`; Chromium launched and the site checks completed. The failure was in the QA runner's browser path, not the site's HTML or JavaScript, so no site source change was indicated.

## Results

- Browser checks at 390×844 and 1440×900 covered `/`, collections, contact, gallery, story, testimonials, `shop.html`, and `thanks.html`. All returned HTTP 200; redirects resolved to their expected pages.
- No JavaScript/page errors, failed HTTP responses, or horizontal overflow on the checked routes.
- Lazy-loaded images were checked after scrolling: 31 on home, 89 on collections, 47 on gallery, 2 on contact, 3 on story, and 2 on testimonials; all loaded. Contact page rendered one form; it was not submitted.
- Homepage mobile and desktop screenshots were captured and reviewed. No visible clipping or overlap.
- Lighthouse on staging: performance 85, accessibility 100 (targets: 80 and 90).
- Linkinator scanned 43 links; all passed.
- Approved repository test routine `test.run` found zero tests (`NO TESTS RAN`, exit code 5). The repository has no package manifest or build script.

The staging QA rerun passed. To prevent recurrence, the QA gate should export `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/ms-playwright`; its runner configuration is outside this repository. The preview email remains held; no deployment or client contact was performed.
